title: Separable approximation to a uniformizer root
statement: Let $p$ be prime, let $R$ be a complete discrete valuation ring of characteristic $p$, let $t$ be a uniformizer, and let $F=\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] [def-pc-field-extension]. For every integer $n>1$ there is a finite separable extension $F'/F$ of degree $p$ whose integral closure $R'$ of $R$ is a complete discrete valuation ring [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. There exist a uniformizer $s$ of $R'$ and $a\in R'$ with $t=s^p+s^{np}a$. The residue map $R/(t)\to R'/(s)$ is an isomorphism and $(t)R'=(s)^p$.

source.place: Tag 09EW, lemma-make-degree-q-extension, characteristic p and q=p, including the second approximation; completeness of the finite integral closure is the complete-DVR specialization.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-epp-approximate-uniformizer-root] with $E=F$, $\pi=t$, $r=1$ and $h=n$, so $q=p^1=p$. Its hypotheses are exactly the given primeness, characteristic, completeness and uniformizer hypotheses, and $1\geq1$, $n>1$. Rename its $E_1,R_1,t$ as $F\prime,R\prime,s$. It gives a separable extension of degree $p$, its complete DVR integral closure, the unchanged residue field, $\mathfrak m_RR\prime=\mathfrak m_{R\prime}^{p}$, and $s^p=t+s^{np}b\prime$ for some $b\prime\in R\prime$.

source.place: Tag 09EW, lemma-make-degree-q-extension, q=p; the second displayed approximation, specialized through lem-sfb-epp-approximate-uniformizer-root.

proof.text: Set $a=-b\prime\in R\prime$. Rearranging the last equality gives $t=s^p+s^{np}a$, including in characteristic $2$. Since $t$ and $s$ are uniformizers, [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] identifies $\mathfrak m_R=(t)$ and $\mathfrak m_{R\prime}=(s)$. Thus the residue-field identification supplied in step 1 is the induced isomorphism $R/(t)\to R\prime/(s)$, and the ideal equality supplied there is $(t)R\prime=(s)^p$. These are all the remaining clauses.

source.place: Tag 09EW, lemma-make-degree-q-extension, q=p; the second displayed approximation, specialized through lem-sfb-epp-approximate-uniformizer-root.

lean.statement: theorem exists_separable_uniformizer_approximation (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] [CharP R p] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R] (F : Type v) [Field F] [Algebra R F] [IsFractionRing R F] (t : R) (ht : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t}) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) : ∃ (L : Type v) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra F L) (_ : Algebra R L) (_ : IsScalarTower R F L) (_ : Module.Finite F L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable F L) (hS : IsDiscreteValuationRing (integralClosure R L)), Module.finrank F L = p ∧ IsAdicComplete (@IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure R L) _ hS.toIsLocalRing) (integralClosure R L) ∧ ∃ s a : integralClosure R L, @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure R L) _ hS.toIsLocalRing = Ideal.span {s} ∧ algebraMap R (integralClosure R L) t = s ^ p + s ^ (n * p) * a ∧ (∃ e : R ⧸ Ideal.span {t} ≃+* (integralClosure R L) ⧸ Ideal.span {s}, ∀ x : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t}) x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {s}) (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L) x)) ∧ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)) (Ideal.span {t}) = (Ideal.span {s}) ^ p
